newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Rabo unit nets PLN 1.3 mln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Polish Rabo unit nets PLN 1.3 mln in 1996.

text.p: The Polish unit of Dutch Rabobank, Rabo-BRP Polska SA, netted 1.3 million zlotys last year, 400,000 less than in 1995, the Polish bank's president said on Thursday.
Dariusz Ledworowski, quoted by PAP news agency, said the bank's gross profit fell 200,000 zlotys to 2.6 million zlotys last year.
Ledworowski said the bank planned to triple profit, net assets and loan portfolio in 1997 as well as offer new products in corporate banking and foreign trade servicing.
The bank's total balance sheet was 200.4 million zlotys and its solvency ratio 47.8 percent in 1996. The bank's total loan portfolio amounted to 100.8 million zlotys.
